message.content:
This is a CBP ruling topic: H-frame wire sign stakes. I recall that CBP classified them as articles of iron or steel wire, under 7326.20 (articles of iron or steel wire) rather than 7326.90. Wire-welded frames are made of wire, so 7326.20.0070 ("Other" articles of iron or steel wire) seems plausible. The subheading 7326.20.00 splits into 7326.20.0010 (bird cages), 7326.20.0020 (fish traps, etc.), 7326.20.0030 (other, of wire, hand-held...?), and 7326.20.0050 (Other: Other... ). I recall 7326.20.0070 as "Other", and 7326.20.0071 is the current statistical suffix. The current schedule has 7326.20.0020 for "Fishing creels, fishing traps...", 7326.20.0030 for "Collapsible cages and kennels...?", 7326.20.0050 for "Birdcages...?", and 7326.20.0070 for "Other: Other" in some versions, while newer versions use 7326.20.0071 for Other. I'll go with 7326.20.0071.

{"hts_code": "7326.20.0071", "reason": "The welded galvanized steel wire H-frame is an article of iron or steel wire classified in heading 7326, subheading 7326.20 (other articles of iron or steel wire), in the residual 'other' provision."}
